E4Plus1.uk.description: Simprovised: Homer turns to improvisational comedy to bolster his public speaking. Marge decides to upgrade Bart's tumbledown treehouse, but he questions her building skills. (S27 Ep21/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Orange Is the New Yellow: Marge is arrested for neglect after letting Bart go to the park alone, but finds that prison gives her a break from the demands of family life. (S27 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The celebrity Goggleboxers, including Rylan and Mo Gilligan, watch MILF Manor, Under Paris, Bake Off: The Professionals, The Supervet, Countdown and The Motorway Hotel. (S6 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Britain's top armchair critics watch The Celebrity Traitors, Trigger Point, Michael McIntyre's The Wheel, Bake Off, Love Is Blind, DIY SOS and BBC News (clocks). (S26 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Celebrity Traitors is on this time. There's Game of Wool: Britain's Best Knitter. And Trigger Point, Hunted, Squid Game: The Challenge and Hamza's Hidden Wild Isles. (S26 Ep10) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Nathania's writing a dissertation about marriage as a form of punishment in fairy tales, but is songwriter Dan - who hasn't had a girlfriend since school - her Prince Charming? (S3 Ep6/9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mula, who was stood up on her last date, is hoping round two will be better. Her blind date is another returner, funny man AJ, who compares women to a bucket of KFC. (S3 Ep7/9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Britain's top armchair critics watch The Celebrity Traitors, Trigger Point, Michael McIntyre's The Wheel, Bake Off, Love Is Blind, DIY SOS and BBC News (clocks). (S26 Ep9) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Celebrity Traitors is on this time. There's Game of Wool: Britain's Best Knitter. And Trigger Point, Hunted, Squid Game: The Challenge and Hamza's Hidden Wild Isles. (S26 Ep10) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Davide: In Boston, Gordon Ramsay visits Davide, an Italian restaurant that's been run into the ground by brothers Frank and Anthony. Can they learn to trust each other again? (S4 Ep5) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Café Kingston: In California, Gordon visits Jamaican restaurant Café Kingston. He meets micromanaging owner Dr Una Morris, who's also a radiotherapist. (S4 Ep11) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks Omnibus
E4Plus1.uk.description: A new cellmate spells danger for Lucas, forcing Dillon to take desperate measures. Theresa pushes Mercedes to give Warren another chance. Diane and Tony lie to protect their loved ones.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Yes-Woman: To be less negative, Claire rebrands herself as the woman who says 'yes', and inadvertently approves of Luke's new relationship with a colleague. (S10 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Can't Elope: Haley and Dylan's plan to quietly elope before the babies are born does not go as hoped. Jay tries to get his new business off the ground by courting an Insta celeb. (S10 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: My Spy
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2020) Family action comedy. A CIA agent (Dave Bautista) gets the run-around from a nine-year-old girl when he's sent to keep an eye on her family. With Chloe Coleman.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Live: Sunday Brunch
E4Plus1.uk.description: Maisie Adam and Sam Campbell talk about the new series of Last One Laughing. Andi Osho chats about her new book. Plus: Lucinda Light, Glenn Tilbrook and music from Don Broco.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sheep.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: One couple are smitten on honeymoon. Another are very much not. And two new couples get hitched, including flashy English groom Danny. (S13 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The experiment intensifies. Gia considers taking a big step after years of celibacy, while tensions explode in Fiji for Bec and Danny. (S13 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2017) Fantasy adventure sequel with Dwayne Johnson, Karen Gillan, Kevin Hart and Jack Black. Four teenagers are sucked into the Jumanji video game to complete a dangerous quest.

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: The Amazing Race Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Eleven Aussie celebs are paired up with close ones in a thrilling, globe-trotting race to win money for charity. First stop: the busy streets of New Delhi. (S7 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa's Belly: Bart and Lisa have to take steroids after getting an infection at a waterpark - and the new drugs have some alarming side effects, particularly for Lisa. (S33 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Portrait of a Lackey on Fire: Smithers tires of Mr Burns' indifference and finds solace in the arms of affectionate fashion designer Michael de Graaf. (S33 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Transporter 2
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2005) Violent action-thriller starring Jason Statham as the tough courier Frank Martin, who's hired to guard a government drugs czar's son. But his mission soon lurches towards disaster.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: The first episode of the daring dating show. Music producer Aina wants to find someone adventurous. Designer Mal, who has dated men and women, has all options laid bare before her. (S1 Ep1)
